decision: Recommend one bounded resource-gated evaluation of untested Mitra-v1 zero-shot and a predeclared equal v1/v2 mean, with unchanged v2 matched control. This is a different pretraining-model hypothesis, not a prediction of higher accuracy.
scope: Only local source/history inventory, official HF/GitHub metadata/model cards/config and37800 remote safetensors header bytes. No tensor payload, new group score, dataset labels, model execution, GPU, dependency change or remote license form.

license.research_course_use: Standard Apache-2.0 model-card declaration supports local course/non-commercial experimentation; no TabPFN-style professional-status representation is present in this model card.
license.account_payment: Public anonymous metadata and weight HEAD work; no account, payment or click-accept workflow identified for these official files. No credentials were read.
license.preservation: Keep pinned model-card provenance and upstream Apache license/attribution with any distributed model/code. No third-party weights or predictions.

compatibility.inference_backend: Same model classes and every state tensor shape permit reuse of current FP32weights/MPSbf16, full-key independent-batch SDPA chunk1/threshold512 adapter. Actual strict state_dict load and full-context forward parity still require the resource probe; header identity is not measured inference success.
compatibility.implementation_boundary: Existing mitra.verify_checkpoint hardcodes v2 SHA. A new wrapper must implement its own pinned v1 verifier/loader and reuse unchanged MitraPreprocessor/MitraPredictor/model backend. Do not patch old WEIGHT_SHA or replace v2 files.

pretraining_difference.v1: Official original card describes purely synthetic tasks from a mixture of random classifiers.
pretraining_difference.v2: Official v2 card states unchanged architecture but new HybridSCM prior,10x longer pretraining contexts,3x as many features and a changed optimizer; v2 weights are described as a drop-in replacement.
pretraining_difference.testable_hypothesis: Older mixed-prior weights may make different errors or produce complementary probabilities on this small dataset. They do not add new observed passenger information. A benefit is possible but unproven; v1 may simply be weaker and highly correlated with v2.
pretraining_difference.why_not_a_view_tweak: Every weight file changes to a separately pretrained checkpoint; both runs otherwise hold inputs and inference recipe fixed.

preprocessing.finding: Pinned official sklearn interface defaults to autogluon/mitra-classifier, one ensemble, Tab2D512/12/4, and no quantile transformer or feature-count scaling. Same vendored upstream Preprocessor/core used by our v2 is suitable for the v1 weights.
preprocessing.important_local_difference: Stock wrapper has8192 support cap and OOM-driven support reductions. Do not invoke these stock behaviors: use our existing full-row adapter for4636/8693 support. Keep the exact existing train-only category/missing encoding, mean imputation, constant filter and one fixed random-mirror seed.
preprocessing.fair_input: Original compact13, original missingness, same foldseed, nocontext20/mirror4/fine-tuning/feature search. Query labels never enter preprocessing or inference.

coverage: No v1 weight appears in artifacts/pretrained; inspected Mitra sources/manifests pin only mitra-classifier-2 SHA5ffab0e2cf52f61c5b7c7eb1e8542996736d1023a0212190cc09abc2119a1e09. Existing v2 mirror, adaptation andcontext variants do not evaluate v1.

fixed_first_screen_if_approved.no_search: No seed/weight/threshold/view selection. Threshold0.5 for all. Compute each complete model once per split and reuse only its complete probabilities for the fixed mean; no extra fits for averaging.
fixed_first_screen_if_approved.memory: Sequential v1fit/predict/release then v2fit/predict/release; do not keep two GPU engines resident. Persistence pins both checkpoint SHAs and full training context or stores both portable CPU predictors.
fixed_first_screen_if_approved.failure: Any component failure makes the mean incomplete. No partialensemble, context truncation, precision fallback or borrowed test labels.
fixed_first_screen_if_approved.validation: A new candidate queue/protocol must be frozen before scoring; do not append to the already frozen current group phase. Report v1 and mean regardless of which is better; retain all prior failures.

priority: Small synthetic schema/strictstate load and samebackend serialization check.
Full4636 support +2318 query, compact13, syntheticlabels; record complete prediction and common128 query consistency.
Full8693 support +2318 query using attribute-only/synthetic inputs and syntheticlabels; complete reload prediction with identical thresholds.
resource_probe.fixed_limits: Original MPSfraction.65,CPU4,FP32weights/MPSbf16,query2318,full support,one view;1200s resource-only ceiling. No backward/adaptation probe.
success_checks: All support rows retained and valid complete probabilities
Samebackend reload maxdiff<=2e-6 and identical threshold decisions
Peak/snapshot RSS and MPS driver usage plus walltime
resource_probe.cost: Architecture/state shapes equal v2 suggest similar workload, but no v1 runtime was measured. The fixed mean needs both models, roughly two single-model inference passes per split; freeze complete-stage budget from resource measurements, not a quality assumption.
